assumptions: Wall solved as a 2 DOF Euler-Bernoulli beam line.
Soil response represented by left/right capped Winkler-type springs with carried offsets.

EC7 verification: EC7-BE design approach 1, sets 1 and 2, as in D-Sheet Piling. The phases are first analysed with characteristic values (serviceability, displacements). Every ULS phase is then re-analysed per set from the characteristic state of the previous phase with design soil strength, factored loads and an overdig of the excavation side (EN 1997-1 9.3.2.2: H = lowest support to excavation level for a supported wall, the retained height for a cantilever; rounded down to the cm); its bending moments, shear forces and support forces are multiplied by the factor on effects, displacements are not. Wall and support checks use the design effects of both sets. Support prestress is not factored.
EC7 set 1: loads permanent unfav./fav. x1/1, variable unfav./fav. x1.2/0; tan(phi') /1, c' /1, subgrade modulus /1; effects x1.5; overdig 10 % of H, max 0.5 m.
EC7 set 2: loads permanent unfav./fav. x1/1, variable unfav./fav. x1.1/0; tan(phi') /1.25, c' /1.25, subgrade modulus /1; effects x1; overdig 10 % of H, max 0.5 m.

The partial factors can be changed in the request (ec7_partial_factors); the defaults are the EC7-BE values used in the R1N8 D-Sheet Piling benchmark models. The engineer remains responsible for the factor set.

Section-derived steel wall check per metre: M_Rd = W_pl f_y / gamma_M0 and V_Rd = A_v f_y / (sqrt(3) gamma_M0) (EN 1993-5 5.2.2), cross-section class 1 or 2 assumed. Built-in sections use the ArcelorMittal catalogue W_pl and A_v = t_w (h - t_f) per web (EN 1993-5 5.2.2(4)). Not checked: class 3 sections (W_el), the U-pile factor beta_B, corrosion, M-V and M-N interaction, shear and flexural buckling.
Inclined walls use an approximate horizontal-component treatment for soil and water loads based on the wall angle from vertical.
source_refs: EN 1997-1:2004 Eurocode 7: Geotechnical design - Part 1, section 9 (retaining structures; 9.3.2.2 unforeseen excavation in ec7 mode)
Deltares, D-Sheet Piling user manual: soil spring model between active and passive limits, staged construction and the Eurocode 7 verification procedure (design approach 1, sets 1 and 2)
CUR 166 Damwandconstructies: multilinear bedding (CUR secant moduli) and the Culmann earth-pressure method
EN 1993-5:2007 Eurocode 3: Design of steel structures - Part 5: Piling, 5.2.2 (section-derived sheet-pile wall resistances)
ArcelorMittal Sheet Piling products database, AZ, AZ-700 and AZ-770 section properties (built-in sheet-pile library), https://sheetpiling.arcelormittal.com/products/az-sections

ec7_verification.procedure: EC7-BE design approach 1, sets 1 and 2 (D-Sheet Piling procedure): each ULS phase starts from the characteristic state of the previous phase; design soil strength, factored loads and overdig; moments, shear and support forces times the factor on effects.
